nodes.name: Every 15 Minutes
nodes.notes:
Polls EasyBroker API every 15 minutes for new contact requests.
Uses workflow static data to track last processed contact ID.

parameters.query:
WITH time_ctx AS (
  SELECT is_daytime() AS is_day, current_shift() AS current_shift
),
returning AS (
  SELECT * FROM find_returning_lead($1, $2, $3) LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
  r.conversation_id AS existing_conv_id,
  r.assigned_agent_id,
  r.current_property AS existing_property,
  r.same_property,
  r.mode AS existing_mode,
  t.is_day,
  t.current_shift
FROM time_ctx t
LEFT JOIN returning r ON TRUE;

UPDATE conversations
SET last_message_at = NOW()
WHERE conversation_id = $1::uuid
RETURNING conversation_id, assigned_agent_id, lead_name;
SELECT whatsapp_number FROM agents WHERE agent_id = $1;

SELECT u.*, $5 AS lead_phone, $6 AS lead_name, $2 AS property_id, $7 AS property_title, $8 AS property_price, $9 AS cache_property_id, $10::jsonb AS cache_payload, NULL::text AS assigned_agent_id
FROM upsert_lead_opportunity($1::uuid, $2, NULL, $4, $5, 'easybroker', $11, 'captured') u;

INSERT INTO properties_cache (property_id, payload)
VALUES ($1, $2::jsonb)
ON CONFLICT (property_id) DO UPDATE
  SET payload = EXCLUDED.payload, fetched_at = NOW();

WITH c AS (
  INSERT INTO conversations (lead_phone, lead_name, lead_email, current_property, mode, source, arrived_during)
  VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, 'night_queued', $5, 'night')
  RETURNING conversation_id, lead_phone, lead_name, current_property
)
SELECT c.*, u.opportunity_id, u.should_route
FROM c
CROSS JOIN LATERAL upsert_lead_opportunity(c.conversation_id, $4, NULL, $3, $7, $5, $6, 'queued_night') u;

INSERT INTO night_queue (conversation_id, source, lead_phone, lead_name, property_id, lead_email, opportunity_id)
SELECT $1::uuid, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7::bigint
WHERE $7::bigint IS NOT NULL
ON CONFLICT (opportunity_id) WHERE opportunity_id IS NOT NULL DO NOTHING;
